fine_lines.title: tell vs say
fine_lines.explanation_ar: tell تعني يُخبر أو يأمر، وتأتي بعدها غالبًا الشخص الذي نخبره (مفعول غير مباشر): tell me, told you. say تعني يقول، والتركيز على الكلمات نفسها، ولا يأتي بعدها الشخص مباشرة؛ إذا أردنا ذكره نقول say to someone. نقول: tell someone to do something (أمر)، و say that...
fine_lines.explanation_en: Tell means to inform or instruct, and is almost always followed by the person (indirect object): tell me, told you. Say means to express words; it focuses on the words and is not followed directly by a person (use say to someone). Tell someone to do something; say that...

examples.sentence: I told you to wait for me!
I said to read the instructions carefully.

fine_lines.title: trash vs treasure
fine_lines.explanation_ar: trash = أشياء لا قيمة لها نرميها. treasure = شيء ثمين جدًا. Sometimes trash is treasure = أحيانًا يكون ما يرميه الناس ثمينًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Trash is worthless things we throw away. Treasure is something very valuable. Sometimes trash is treasure.

examples.sentence: This broken cup is just trash.
My grandmother's old photos are a treasure.

grammar.title: Tell and say
grammar.explanation_ar: tell (told): بمعنى يُخبر أو يأمر، ويأتي بعده دائمًا تقريبًا الشخص (مفعول غير مباشر): tell me, she told us. ومع الأمر: tell + شخص + to + فعل: I told you to wait. say (said): بمعنى يقول، والتركيز على الكلمات. يأتي بعده الكلام مباشرة أو that: It said, "Use me." / She said that... وإذا ذكرنا الشخص نستخدم to: She said to me... خطأ شائع: لا نقول She said me، بل She told me أو She said to me.
grammar.explanation_en: Tell (told) means to inform or instruct and is almost always followed by the person: tell me, she told us. For orders: tell + person + to + verb: I told you to wait. Say (said) means to express words; the focus is on the words: It said, "Use me." / She said that... To add the person, use to: She said to me... Common mistake: not She said me, but She told me or She said to me.
examples: I told you to wait for me!
You told me not to start without you.
But you said to bring in trash.

questions.question: She ____ me a funny story.
questions.explanation_en: A person (me) follows, so use told.

questions.question: Anna, I ____ you to read the instructions!
To connect a lamp to electricity is to ____ it ____.
A hard hat that protects your head is a ____.
'I'll be right back' means:
questions.explanation_en: It means I will return very soon.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
choices: He said to me that he was tired.
He said me that he was tired.
He told that he was tired to me.
He told to me he was tired.
questions.explanation_ar: say to + شخص صحيحة، و said me خطأ.
questions.explanation_en: Say to + person is correct; said me is wrong.
